The '''C0-RU Probe''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] which was around during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Bundle" />

==Behind the scenes==
The C0-RU Probe was a player's pet in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was added to the game in Game Update 7.6.1 as a reward for the Galactic Seasons 8 event.<ref name="update">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250226|text=Game Update 7.6.1 Recap}}</ref>
